items.title: Why AI Hasn’t Increased Unemployment, According to Anthropic
items.summary: Anthropic's head of economics makes the case that AI has caused no material rise in unemployment — because it's a skill-biased, labor-augmenting technology, not a replacement one. Plus a headlines run stuffed with the new hot category: model routing, as Stripe circles OpenRouter for $10B.

items.title: DeepSeek pauses its second fundraising round after founder’s leaked investor comments go viral
items.summary:
DeepSeek has suspended its second fundraising round after comments made by founder Liang Wenfeng during private investor meetings were leaked and went viral on Chinese social media, Bloomberg reported on Friday. Liang verbally informed prospective backers to hold off on the round, which had been targeting a pre-money valuation of roughly 480 billion yuan, equivalent […]

items.title: EV owners are more satisfied with their cars than gas car drivers in nearly every category, JD Power finds
items.summary:
Electric vehicle owners are happier with their cars than drivers of combustion vehicles in nearly every category measured, according to JD Power’s 2026 Automotive Performance, Execution, and Layout study released this week. The survey of 78,514 owners of 2026 model-year vehicles found that EVs outscored internal combustion engine cars by 109 points on a 1,000-point […]

items.title: AI chatbots are quietly becoming the uninvited third person in people’s relationships
items.summary:
A Pew Research Center survey published last month found that one in five Americans aged 18 to 29 have used AI chatbots for emotional support or advice, and a separate YouGov poll found that 13 percent of US adults have shared a secret or problem with a chatbot that they had not told any human. […]
